open: Every UK government document that moved this month. Grants, tenders, consultations. One founder is supposed to read all of it.
agent: This page offers its own tools to whatever agent the founder brought with them.
profile: It fills in who they are, from what it already knows. The page marks it as the agent's guess until the founder says yes.
shortlist: Now it works the list. Every call moves the page the founder is looking at. Not a transcript of something that happened somewhere else.
private: Here is the part a website cannot do on its own. The founder tells their agent something the site never sees. And the suggestions change.
decide: When they turn something down, the reason goes back to the agent. It will not offer it again.
brief: The brief is written from what survived the founder's judgement, not the model's.
close: It read all of it. They made the calls. That is the trade WebMCP makes possible.
